newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates remain high on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates remain high on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates remained high on Thursday on a fund shortage and dealers said some banks sought relief from the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's discount counter.
"The market started with overnights being struck at yesterday's levels of 19.90 and 20 percent and the whole day's trading remained restricted to these levels," a dealer said.
Five-day funds were exchnaged around 19.75 percent while one-week bids and offers were quoted at 15.75 and 16.25 percent respectively, dealers said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
